plugin.name: scottland
plugin._long: Spatial window layout: windows scale down toward the side rails and snap into widgets.

option.name: unfocused_edge_tone_light
option._short: Unfocused edge tone for light scheme
option._long: Gray level of an unfocused edge on a light desktop. Zero is black and one is white.

option.name: unfocused_edge_tone_dark
option._short: Unfocused edge tone for dark scheme
option._long: Gray level of an unfocused edge on a dark desktop. Zero is black and one is white.

option.name: unfocused_edge_strength
option._long: How strongly an unfocused neutral tint shows in goo or its fallback halo. Zero is clear glass; one is the full tint.

option.name: goo_breath_keys
option._long: Keep the lower-cost interpolated breath cache on. Turn off live to draw every breathing strip exactly; no reload is needed.

option.name: goo_depth
option._long: Height of the rounded liquid above the screen, in logical pixels. Higher makes a deeper lens; zero flattens it.

option.name: goo_profile
option._long: How strongly the rounded bead climbs the window wall. Higher raises the inner meniscus; zero leaves a free rounded bead.

option.name: goo_soak
option._long: Weak wallpaper color washes through thicker goo, fading near window edges so state colors stay clear. Zero turns it off.

option.name: goo_overlap_film
option._long: Width of goo over windows behind. Higher covers a wider strip; zero hides the film.

option.name: goo_hover_cloudiness
option._long: Milkiness of a nearby corner or side. Higher makes the whole control denser; zero keeps it clear.

option.name: goo_hover_emissivity
option._long: Light from inside a nearby corner or side. Higher glows brighter; zero turns the glow off.

option.name: goo_hover_distance
option._long: How far away a control starts highlighting. Higher responds sooner; zero responds only over it.

option.name: widget_bounce
option._long: Size overshoot when widgets expand or contract. 0 disables the bounce; 0.04 gives a small single bounce. Large contractions limit overshoot to keep the card recognizable.

option.name: window_avoidance_always
option._long: Keep windows visually shifted to reserve space for Window mode hints outside Window mode. This affects no geometry, zone, scale, placement memory or widget state.

option.name: hint_avoidance_always
option._long: Compatibility alias for window_avoidance_always. New configuration should use that key.

option.name: alt_hold_delay
option._long: Hold Alt alone for this long to show compositor window hints. Alt+Tab and Alt+Shift+Tab switch center windows; other quick chords keep their app and desktop routing. Once window mode opens, its keys control windows until Alt is released. Window mode uses Alt alone to show hints and focus center windows without hiding the others.

option.name: center_switcher_next
option._long: Preview the next center-zone window by recent use. Releasing Alt focuses and raises it. Window mode uses this key so you can focus a center window while keeping the others visible.

option.name: center_switcher_previous
option._long: Preview the previous center-zone window by recent use. Releasing Alt focuses and raises it. Window mode uses this key so you can focus a center window while keeping the others visible.

option.name: window_double_tap_delay
option._long: After releasing a complete hint, begin typing it again within this interval to send the window to its rail widget. The repeat must be completed; key hold time and typing the remaining letters do not spend the interval. A window already on the rail stays put unless its collapsed-widget hint peek is active. Slower presses follow the starting-zone cycle.

option.name: window_hold_delay
option._long: Holding an unfocused window's hint this long, without releasing it, places it side by side with the focused window. A shorter press stays a tap. Key auto-repeat never counts.

option.name: cycle_overshoot
option._long: Elastic settlement of position and scale when a keyboard hint moves a window. Higher gives a larger overshoot; zero keeps the original motion. Screen edges limit the overshoot. Drags, coasts and widget morphs are unaffected.

option.name: center_width
option._long: Width of the full-scale center zone, as a percentage of the screen width.

option.name: rail_width
option._long: Width of each widget rail at the far left and right, as a percentage of the screen width.

option.name: min_scale
option._long: Scale of windows where the continuous zones meet the widget rails (and on the rails).

option.name: max_scale
option._short: Largest scale in the side zones
option._long: Scale of windows where the continuous zones meet the center zone. Below 100%, windows animate down to it when they leave the center.

option.name: blend_width
option._long: Width of the band just outside the center zone where the scale eases smoothly from 100% into the scale curve, instead of changing abruptly at the edge.

option.name: color_scheme
option._long: "dark" or "light": draws halos and the close dot to suit a dark or light desktop. Set by scottland-color-scheme from the desktop's color scheme.

option.name: accent_color
option._long: The focused window's halo color. Set by scottland-color-scheme from the desktop's accent color, or by an integration.

option.name: touch_scroll_wheel
option._long: Apps (app-id regex) that get touchscreen scrolling as a high-resolution wheel instead of smooth scrolling, for apps that ignore smooth scrolling from Scottland's pointer.

option.name: minimize_widget
option._long: Collapses all widgets to just their icons, or, if they all are, expands them back. This key reduces peripheral detail while keeping every window visible.

option.name: attention_color
option._long: The secondary highlight a widget's halo takes while its app needs attention (it also breathes). Set by scottland-color-scheme from the desktop's palette, or by an integration.

option.name: resize_alt
option._long: Another binding for the center-anchored resize, for trackpads without a comfortable right-drag.

option.name: touchpad_gestures
option._long: Three-finger drag on a touchpad moves the window under the pointer; a three-finger click-drag resizes it around its center. A three-finger click without moving is still a middle click.

option.name: lift_delay
option._long: How long a finger must rest still on a window before the window lifts and follows it. A touch that moves sooner belongs to the app.

option.name: sounds
option._long: Play Scottland's synthesized interface sounds (e.g. the pop when a window lifts).

option.name: scale_curve
option._long: Scale across the continuous zones as points "t:scale", t from 0 (center zone edge) to 1 (widget rail), joined smoothly. Empty: straight line from max_scale to min_scale.

option.name: move_shift
option._short: Move a window at fixed scale

option.name: resize
option._long: Grow or shrink the window under the pointer symmetrically around its center.

option.name: touch_scroll
option._short: Touch scrolling for apps that ignore touch
option._long: For apps whose app-id matches (case-insensitive regex), a one-finger drag on the touchscreen scrolls (with momentum) and a quick tap clicks. Set an entry to empty to turn a shipped default off.

entry.name: apps
entry._long: Regular expression matched against the app-id.

option.name: key_remaps
option._long: For apps whose app-id matches, turn one key combination into another before bindings and the app see it. This lets the same action have the intended editing effect in matching apps.

entry.name: apps
entry._long: Regular expression matched against the focused app-id (case-insensitive).

entry.name: from
entry._long: Key combination, e.g. CTRL+W (xkb keysym names).

option.name: release_bindings
option._long: Run a command when a key is released.

entry.name: key
entry._long: xkb keysym name (e.g. Super_L) or code:N.

entry.name: command
entry._long: Command to run when the key is released.
